clues: This is a big port city on the west coast of India, by the sea. Ships have come here for spice trade since old times.
From June to September, the monsoon winds push heavy rain in from the sea. High hills help trap that rain on this coast.
In 1503, men from Portugal set up a fort by this port. They held the town for a long time, till the Dutch took it.
The airport here was the first in the world to run just on sun power. No other airport on Earth had done that before it.
Huge fishing nets, brought from China long ago, are the famed sign of this city. Tourists love to come and look at them by the sea.
